accommodation.name: Arrival court and entrance
accommodation.limitation: Driveway turning geometry, gate, lighting, and planting detail remain for construction.

accommodation.name: Great room
accommodation.limitation: Exterior envelope and thresholds are committed; interior partitions, kitchen, bar, furnishings, and service fit-out are deferred.

accommodation.name: Ocean garden suite 01
accommodation.limitation: Suite envelope capacity only; bedroom/bath/dressing partitions and rear corridor door are deferred.

accommodation.name: Upper west suite 02
accommodation.limitation: Dedicated exterior door, internal suite partitions, and stair/landing must be constructed in the next stage; this proposal reserves both.

accommodation.name: Ocean terrace
accommodation.limitation: Loose furniture and shade furnishings are deferred; terrace must be split around basin construction.

accommodation.name: Infinity-view pool court
accommodation.limitation: Requires explicit basin floor, four basin walls, coping segments, and water. Overflow/catch basin hydraulics and true infinity-edge performance are unsupported.

accommodation.name: Ocean lounge pavilion
accommodation.limitation: A dry connecting path from pool coping to pavilion deck must be constructed; pavilion furniture is component-defined rather than independently editable.

limitations: Matching selected anchors does not verify enclosure, room independence, navigability, headroom, actual profile surfaces, architectural quality or completed usable rooms. Existing construction and architectural review still apply.
